title: CodeSynapse Helm chart values
description: Values of the codesynapse chart. Each store section is checked again by its subchart's own values.schema.json.

global.description: Shared with the store subcharts. Left open for an umbrella chart's own globals.

existingSecret.description: Required at install. The Secret with CODESYNAPSE_API_TOKEN, CODESYNAPSE_MCP_TOKEN, NEBULA_PASSWORD, METRICS_PASSWORD, SECRET_KEY and POSTGRES_PASSWORD (in-chart PostgreSQL) or CODESYNAPSE_DATABASE_URL (external). Optional: CODESYNAPSE_GIT_TOKENS, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, MILVUS_TOKEN.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for a private registry or mirror, e.g. [{name: ghcr}].

networkPolicies.description: Each component and store accepts only the pods that need it.

kedaNamespace.description: With worker.queueScaling.mode=keda: the namespace of KEDA's operator, whose pods PostgreSQL then also accepts (it reads the jobs table). Empty keeps PostgreSQL to this release's pods.

common.description: The library chart of shared helpers; Helm adds its section. Nothing to set.

registry.description: Registry and owner of the api, worker, mcp and web images.

tag.description: Defaults to the chart's appVersion (the release tag).

publicAPIURL.description: Where the Claude Code bridge reaches the API; shown on the Agents page.

environment.description: Environment name on metrics and traces.

admin.description: The administrator made at first start. Its password is generated into the Secret <release>-admin (kept across upgrades) or read from existingSecret. With enabled false the first sign-up becomes the root account instead.

enabled.description: Create the administrator "admin" when the installation has no accounts.

existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret with the key CODESYNAPSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 12 characters), used instead of a generated password.

cookieSecure.description: Session cookies need TLS; false only for plain-HTTP local tests.

trustedProxies.description: Comma-separated CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted. The web pods forward each user's address from the pod network.

auditRetentionDays.description: Days the audit log is kept.

vulnScan.description: Look up dependency vulnerabilities on osv.dev.

licenseLookup.description: Ask deps.dev for licences not found on disk and for deprecated or outdated dependencies (sends package names and versions).

allowNetwork.description: Module downloads during ingest: trusted repositories only.

allowPush.description: Fix branches for accepted review comments (needs Git tokens with write access).

allowPrivateGit.description: Allow Git remotes on private and loopback addresses.

mcpUsage.description: Daily MCP usage counters for the Statistics page.

llmConfig.description: The content of config/llm.yaml (see config/llm.example.yaml). Empty: no AI tasks. API keys go in the Secret, referenced by api_key_env.

mcp.description: Keeps no state between requests: run two or more for availability. With replicas > 1 it gets a disruption budget and pods spread over nodes and zones.

stateless.description: No transport session between requests, so any replica answers any request without sticky sessions.

toolsets.description: Toolsets for connections that name none: all, or core plus a comma list (repos, docs, security, architecture, memory, cleanup, reviews, identity). Clients choose their own with /mcp?toolsets=...

worker.description: Runs clone, sync and index jobs and AI tasks. Scales by hand, or on queued jobs with queueScaling: a worker stopped by a scale-down leaves its job to another one only after the job's lease ran out. It never pushes: fix branches belong to fixWorker.

roles.description: Comma-separated job roles: ingest (clone, sync, index) and ai. The fix role runs in fixWorker.

queueScaling.description: Scale workers on the jobs queued or running. The chart installs neither tool: hpa needs an external-metrics adapter serving metricName, keda needs KEDA. replicas is ignored when a mode is on.

mode.description: none keeps replicas; hpa adds a HorizontalPodAutoscaler on an external metric; keda adds a KEDA ScaledObject that counts jobs in PostgreSQL.

jobsPerWorker.description: Jobs one worker takes before another is added.

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds of low load before workers are removed; one worker goes per third of it. A worker removed mid-job leaves it to another only after its lease.

metricName.description: hpa only: the external metric the adapter serves, the sum of codesynapse_jobs_active over the worker job kinds.

restrictEgress.description: Limit what workers (and the fix worker) can reach to DNS, the stores of this release and HTTPS to public addresses. Needs a network plugin that enforces NetworkPolicy. Private addresses (an external store, a self-hosted Git server, a local model) need a rule in egressAllow.

egressAllow.description: Extra destinations workers may reach when restrictEgress is on.

ports.description: TCP ports; omit for every port.

fixWorker.description: Pushes fix branches for accepted review comments. The only worker allowed to push (CODESYNAPSE_ALLOW_PUSH); needs features.allowPush=true and a Git token with write access.

roles.description: Job roles of this worker: fix.

workspace.description: Clones of repositories added by URL. api, worker and mcp mount it: on a multi-node cluster use a ReadWriteMany storage class.

ingress.description: Path /mcp goes to the MCP service, everything else to the dashboard.

postgresql.description: In-chart PostgreSQL. When disabled, put the database URL in the Secret as CODESYNAPSE_DATABASE_URL.

externalAddrs.description: When disabled: the graphd addresses (host:9669, comma separated). The root password stays NEBULA_PASSWORD in the Secret; in the chart it is at most 24 characters (NebulaGraph's limit).

space.description: The graph space's layout, fixed when CodeSynapse first creates it; changing it later does not reshape an existing space.

partitions.description: Partitions the graph is split into, spread over the storaged hosts.

replicas.description: Copies of each partition: odd, at most the storaged hosts. The in-chart NebulaGraph needs 1; a cluster wants 3.

externalURL.description: When disabled: the Milvus proxy URL (http(s)://host:19530); empty turns memory vectors off. With authentication, MILVUS_TOKEN in the Secret.
When disabled: the base URL; empty turns metrics export off.
When disabled: the full OTLP/HTTP traces endpoint; empty turns export off.

autoscaling.description: CPU autoscaling; replicas is then ignored. Needs metrics-server.

scaledComponent.description: Keeps no state between requests: run two or more for availability. With replicas > 1 it gets a disruption budget and pods spread over nodes and zones.

store.description: A store subchart, on by default. For production, prefer stores you run and back up yourself: set enabled=false and set externalURL. The subchart's values.schema.json lists what else can be set (image, size, storageClass, resources, retention).
